name: Sigma merge / average family
plain: Blends schedules of the same length. Fixed blend, a per-index gradual blend from p to 1−p, or a mean of up to 25 inputs. Weighted scheduler mixing also belongs here.
math:
merge: p·σ₁+(1−p)·σ₂.
gradual: w_i goes linearly p→1−p; w_i·σ₁+(1−w_i)·σ₂.
many: mean(σ₁..σ_k).
SchedulerMixer: Σ w_k·schedule_k with six named core schedules; weights are not normalised.

providers.author: BlakeOne
providers.note: mixes by name; default weights 0.5 sgm_uniform + 0.5 ddim_uniform

label: from code
surprise: SchedulerMixer does not normalise weights, so weights summing to more than 1 scale the whole schedule; its defaults (0.5 + 0.5) happen to sum to 1 (node.py:33-41).
